title: VarSchema
description: Normalized shape of a single Terraform variable, as extracted by WS-B (Schema Parser) from a module's variables.tf. This is the frozen Phase 0 contract WS-B, WS-C, and WS-H all build against independently. A module's full schema is a VarSchema[] (see var-schema.example.json).

name.description: Variable name, exactly as declared in variables.tf (e.g. "size").

type.description: Coarse type kind, derived from typeexpr.TypeConstraint. "unsupported" triggers the raw-JSON-field UI fallback (see ARCHITECTURE.md edge cases).

type_raw.description: The original HCL type expression text, for display, e.g. "list(object({name=string, size=string}))".

element_type.description: For list/set/map: the VarSchema-shaped type of elements. For object: see `object_fields`. Omitted for scalar types.

object_fields.description: For type="object": field name -> VarSchema (recursive, one level = one nesting level for the Phase 1 form-rendering cap of 2 levels).

default.description: The variable's default value, if any, as a native JSON value matching `type`. Absent (not null) when the module declares no default.

has_default.description: Explicit flag distinguishing "no default declared" from "default is null" — do not infer this from `default`'s presence alone.

required.description: true when has_default is false and nullable is false — precomputed for the frontend so it doesn't need to re-derive the rule.

description.description: The variable's description string from variables.tf, shown as form help text.

sensitive.description: Mirrors variables.tf's sensitive = true. Drives the Phase 1 UI warning at preview time (values are still included in generated tfvars per the locked decision).

nullable.description: Mirrors variables.tf's nullable attribute (defaults to true in Terraform when unset).

validations.description: variable { validation { ... } } blocks, surfaced as UI help text only — server-side type/shape checking is the Phase 1 authoritative check, not re-implementation of these conditions.
